checking: Checking the photo … You can carry on with the form in the meantime.
arrived_live: {count, plural, one {We suggested # detail from the photo. Please check it.} other {We suggested # details from the photo. Please check them.}}
none_live: We could not tell the details reliably from the photo. Please fill them in yourself.
suggested_a11y: Suggested from the photo. Please check it.
note_continue: We filled in some fields with suggestions from the photo. AI can be wrong, so please check them before you continue.
note_save: We filled in some fields with suggestions from the photo. AI can be wrong, so please check them before you save.
note_publish: We filled in some fields with suggestions from the photo. AI can be wrong, so please check them before you publish.
low_confidence: We could not tell this reliably from the photo. Please choose it yourself.
low_confidence_breed: We could not tell the breed reliably from the photo. Choose it yourself, or pick Mixed breed or Not sure.
collar_hint: There seems to be a collar in the photo. If you can, describe it: colour, tag, bell.
collar_hint_note: There seems to be a collar in the photo. If you can, mention it in the note.
species_differs: {species, select, dog {The photo looks like a dog.} cat {The photo looks like a cat.} other {The photo looks like a different species.}} If your choice is right, leave it as it is.
species_switch: {species, select, dog {Choose dog} cat {Choose cat} other {Change species}}
no_animal_title: We cannot see a dog or cat in this photo
no_animal_body: Try another photo where the animal is clearly visible. If the animal is in the photo, keep it and fill in the details yourself.
other_animal_title: This looks like a different kind of animal
other_animal_body: Reports on Najdimo are for dogs and cats only. If the photo shows a dog or cat, keep it and fill in the details yourself.
multiple_title: There seem to be several animals in this photo
multiple_body: If you can, choose another or a cropped photo that shows just one animal. Otherwise check that the suggestions are about the right animal.
info_body: An AI model looks at the photo. It suggests the species, breed, colours, pattern, size and collar, and checks whether a person or inappropriate content is prominent in the photo. We send the provider only a smaller copy of the photo, with no metadata or location and nothing about you or the report. We use the same copy to look for similar photos when matching. Suggestions can be wrong and become part of the report only once you confirm them.
